name: code-terminal-run
description: A token-chrome terminal panel runs one command: the prompt line types deterministically behind an integer-cycle caret, executes after a beat, and output lines print one per cue before a fresh prompt appears.

vars.description: Leading glyph before the command and the trailing prompt. Empty string hides it.
Keystroke rhythm: uniform fixed steps or seeded human chunks.
Comma-separated seconds relative to mount start; cue N sets when output line N prints. Empty uses the authored rhythm.
Color of the prompt glyph and caret.
Outgoing transition. Frame roots own transitions; none holds the end frame.
